english.title: Make a statement or provide information that is false or misleading to a person enforcing the regulations
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[made a statement,]_
(B)_[provided information,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY STATEMENT OR INFORMATION..), that was false or misleading to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person acting in relation to the enforcement of the Equine Identification (England) Regulations 2018 or Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2015/262
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 26(c) and 36 of the Equine Identification (England) Regulations 2018.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
make a statement or provide information
that is false or misleading
to any person enforcing these regs or the EU Regulation

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 37(1) provides that an enforcing authority may impose a civil sanction, or a combination of civil sanctions, under Part 6 against a person if the authority is satisfied beyond reasonable doubt that the person is guilty of this offence.
(ii) Regulation 37(2) provides that criminal proceedings may not be started or continued against a person if any enforcing authority, in respect of the offence, chooses to apply civil sanctions and services a compliance notice, non-compliance penalty notice or fixed monetary penalty notice on that person.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 monthsNote
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
